name: Regular User - Documents Required Flow
goal: Ensure a regular user can access the 'Documents required' information and return to the main menu.
constraints: User type is 'users'; user selects 'Documents required'; uses 'Go Back' to return.

phases.description: User is detected as regular user and selects 'Documents required'.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot displays the documents required message.
Bot returns to main menu options.

manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
